plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Welding Technology, Associate of Applied Science' program page (Major Code: 4661A), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/trade-and-industry-department/welding-technology/welding-technology-associate-of-applied-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Applied Science (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 63, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 63'); tables print 15/13/9/12/14 and sum exactly. Summer Semester Freshman Year choice modeled honestly: the catalog lists 'WELD 285 Cooperative Education 1-9 Credits OR WELD 235 GMAW/FCAW (3 cr) AND WELD 237 GTAW Project Application (3 cr)' with a printed semester total of 9 (3 SOCS GE + 6); modeled as one 6-credit choice slot, the fixed-credit path that sums to the printed 9. Choice slots: MATH GE / SOCS GE / COMM GE / ELEC GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
